About

从主播到品牌操盘手：把三个互不信任的圈层，接到同一张桌子上From News Anchor to Brand Operator: Bringing Three Mutually Distrustful Worlds to One Table

刘元元曾任 Astro 电视台主播与节目制作人，其后独立发起理财投资内容品牌全家私房钱 MoneyMoneyHome。她的核心能力不只是「做内容」，而是用内容把原本互不信任、也互相听不懂彼此语言的三方——监管机构、机构资方与产业方、普通大众家庭——同时请上桌，并让内容成为三方之间可以互相理解的共同语言。Liew Yuan Yuan was formerly a news anchor and producer at Astro TV, before independently launching MoneyMoneyHome, a personal finance and investment content brand. Her core strength isn't just “making content” — it's using content to bring three mutually distrustful, mutually unintelligible parties to the same table: regulators, institutional capital and industry players, and everyday households — turning content into a shared language all three can understand.

Content Methodology

内容建立信任，商业价值在信任之外发生Content Builds Trust; Commercial Value Happens Outside It

这套方法论贯穿全家私房钱过去 8 年的所有内容，也是刘元元判断一个新题材、新企划是否值得做的核心标准。This methodology runs through everything MoneyMoneyHome has produced over the past 8 years, and is the core standard Liew Yuan Yuan uses to judge whether a new topic or project is worth pursuing.

01选题：找信息不对称最严重的角落Topic Selection: Find Where Information Asymmetry Is Worst

房产、厂房、企业内幕、稳健投资——她持续选择资讯高度不透明、大众想懂却无从理解的题材切入Property, factories, corporate insider stories, steady investing — she consistently picks topics where information is highly opaque and the public wants to understand but can't

02叙事：用真实人物讲清楚，不做内容内推销Narrative: Real People Explaining Clearly, No In-Content Selling

以真实人物与真实故事拆解专业议题，内容本身完全不涉及任何产品或服务的销售讯息，公信力不被稀释Real people and real stories break down technical subjects; the content carries zero product or service sales messaging, so credibility is never diluted

03转化：信任沉淀之后，价值自然发生Conversion: Once Trust Settles, Value Follows Naturally

商业合作、生意机会与后续转化都发生在内容之外，由专业团队承接，内容本身始终保持中立与可信Commercial partnerships, business opportunities, and follow-up conversion all happen outside the content, handled by a dedicated team — the content itself stays neutral and credible throughout

全家私房钱 2.0

同一套方法论，正在三个题材上同步验证The Same Methodology, Being Validated Across Three Topics at Once

全家私房钱正在重启，以三个企划同步验证「内容建信任」这套方法论在不同题材上的可规模化程度。MoneyMoneyHome is relaunching, running three initiatives in parallel to test how scalable the “content builds trust” methodology is across different topics.

01厂房纪实Factory Files

聚焦厂房与工业地产这个大马最庞大却最不透明的资产类别，以真实故事揭开厂房产业的神秘面纱Focused on factories and industrial property — Malaysia's largest yet least transparent asset class — using real stories to demystify the industry

02美股 Options 企划US Stock Options Project

与资深美股期权讲师合作，出镜的是提供投资陪跑服务的专业理财团队，谈的是如何在期权市场中做穩健、可控风险的布局In partnership with a veteran US options instructor, featuring a professional financial team that provides hands-on investment coaching, on building steady, risk-controlled positions in the options market

The Podcast ・ 核心定位

给已经把生意做起来、正准备走向资本的老板与操盘手看的深度对话节目A Deep-Conversation Show for Owners and Operators Who've Already Built a Business and Are Heading Toward Capital

《说道做到》——用真实交易案例，拆解「钱究竟是怎么在商业世界里真正流动的」：融资、并购、重组、家族企业传承、跨境交易，一集只讲一桩真实案例，讲透结构、动机与代价。Walk The Talk uses real deal case studies to unpack how money actually moves through the business world: fundraising, M&A, restructuring, family business succession, cross-border transactions. Each episode covers exactly one real case, in full — the structure, the motives, and the cost.

节目类别Show Category

不是财经新闻节目，也不是股票贴士频道，更不是创业鸡汤——是一档以真实交易案例为核心的资本操作深度对话节目Not a financial news show, not a stock-tip channel, and definitely not startup motivational talk — a deep-conversation show built entirely around real deal case studies

目标受众Target Audience

中小企业主与家族企业二代、天使／私募投资人、专业服务从业者（律师、会计师、投行、基金经理）、有志跻身资本圈的创业者SME owners and next-gen family business heirs, angel／private equity investors, professionals (lawyers, accountants, bankers, fund managers), and entrepreneurs aiming to break into capital circles

内容形式Format

45–60 分钟长篇对话，每集聚焦一桩真实交易或案例，由当事人或操盘手亲自还原决策过程与谈判细节45–60 minute long-form conversations; each episode centers on one real transaction, walked through firsthand by the person who made the deal

Why This, Why Now, Why Her

市场上不缺财经内容，缺的是敢把真实交易讲透的节目The Market Isn't Short on Financial Content — It's Short on Shows Brave Enough to Lay Out Real Deals in Full

新马华语市场的商业内容大多停留在「新闻转述」或「精神喊话」两个极端，中间那块——真正拆解一桩生意如何被资本运作起来的深度内容——是空白的。Chinese-language business content in Malaysia and Singapore mostly sits at one of two extremes: news recaps or motivational pep talks. The space in between — genuinely unpacking how a business gets run on capital — is empty.

财经新闻类节目Financial News Shows

偏宏观、偏时事，讲市场、讲政策，很少深入单一交易的真实结构与决策细节Macro-leaning and current-affairs focused — markets, policy — but rarely digs into the real structure behind a single deal

创业鸡汤 ／ 励志类节目Startup Motivational Shows

谈心态、谈愿景，缺少具体数字、真实结构与可验证的操作细节Big on mindset and vision, short on hard numbers, real structure, or verifiable operational detail

《说道做到》Walk The Talk

一集一案例，讲结构、讲数字、讲真实的谈判与代价——由真正做过交易的人亲口还原One case per episode — the structure, the numbers, the real negotiation and its cost — told firsthand by someone who actually did the deal

先例验证Prior-Format Proof这不是纸上谈兵——元元在全家私房钱频道已主持过《天哥讲股》系列，邀请真实马股投资人畅谈个股操作心得，整个播放列表累计 15 集、21,961 次观看（云顶大马 GENM 单集 42K 观看、益纳利美昌 INARI 单集 28K 观看），证明「邀请真实操盘手开口谈真实标的」这套形式本身已被市场验证过。This isn't theoretical — on the MoneyMoneyHome channel, Yuan Yuan already hosted a series called Uncle Tian Talks Stocks, inviting real Malaysian stock investors to talk through their actual trading insights — the full playlist runs 15 episodes with 21,961 cumulative views (a single episode on Genting Malaysia drew 42K views, one on Inari Amertron drew 28K) — proof that the format itself, real operators discussing real positions on camera, has already found an audience.

《天哥讲股》YouTube 播放列表，共 15 集，每集观看 14,000–42,000 次The Uncle Tian Talks Stocks YouTube playlist — 15 episodes, 14,000–42,000 views per episode

刘元元过去 8 年已证明自己能同时让监管机构、机构资方与大众市场都愿意开口、愿意信任。这正是让真实操盘手愿意在镜头前讲真话、而不是公关稿的关键前提——这也是《说道做到》能做起来、而非停留在概念阶段的原因。Over the past 8 years, Liew Yuan Yuan has proven she can get regulators, institutional capital, and the mass market to open up and trust her at the same time. That's the precondition for getting real dealmakers to speak candidly on camera instead of reciting a press release — and it's why Walk The Talk can actually get made, not just stay a concept.

嘉宾Guests

用一集深度对话，把自己塑造成「愿意讲真话的操盘手」，触及新马两地企业主、投资人与专业服务从业者，内容不做恶意爆料，充分尊重商业敏感度Use one deep conversation to establish yourself as “the operator who tells it straight,” reaching business owners, investors, and professionals across Malaysia and Singapore — no gotcha exposés, full respect for commercial sensitivity

全家私房钱花了 8 年证明：把复杂的钱讲清楚，大众会信任、机构会合作、监管也会背书。《说道做到》，是把这套能力用在生意本身最核心、也最少人敢讲透的那一层。MoneyMoneyHome spent 8 years proving something: explain complicated money clearly, and the public will trust you, institutions will partner with you, and regulators will vouch for you. Walk The Talk points that same ability at the most core, least-often-told layer of business itself.
